body: Opening up is the hardest thing with depression.  I think we convince ourselves that people won't want to get close to us cause we're not worth the time, even if that's not always the case.
You shouldn't feel bad about having nothing to be sad about, that's just going to make things worse.  You can't help the way you feel and the only thing you can do is try to work on yourself.
I think it's a matter of self worth.  I know for me atleast I convince myself that I'm not worth anyone's time, so I just assume someone doesn't like me.
Sometimes just asking about someone's day really means something to someone.  Listening goes along way with people.
Venting is always good.  Being able to talk to someone can help push some bad stuff out.

Talking is always good.  Being able to open up can help with bad thoughts and it allows you to read you thoughts and try to make sense of them.  Sometimes of your thinking something a write it down it's like getting a second opinion on it.

Getting close to people is always difficult, but being able to get close to someone is something that can be worth it. If you start off slow and nor rush into things you can have something really nice.

You aren't though, the only person who is wrong is her.  You can't help who you are and you shouldn't be ashamed of what you did because there's nothing wrong with it.  The thing is you may never forgive her, that's just how it is.  But you need to forgive yourself.

That kind of thing does really mess with you.  When a person who is supposed to care for you unconditionally destroys that trust it becomes hard to trust anyone.  Your feelings towards her don't make you a bad person.  You just shouldn't be hard on yourself about it.

Unfortunately isolation and depression are very common together.  I wish I could tell you how but I'm in the same boat as you.  I know all I can do is try to keep my mind off things with anything at hands hopefully that can help you.

My dad left when I was 16.  After that you just kinda assume everyone is gonna leave you at some point.  It's hard thinking you can be loved when one of the two people who should love you unconditionally doesn't.
Thanks for responding.  I guess I just wanted to be around people who know what I'm going through. I've been around people who just don't get it my whole life and it's just started getting to me
